steps.reason: Scope the dataset to the exact 7-day window requested before any detection logic runs.
Compute per-account rolling features — particularly % of transactions near the $10,000 threshold and velocity — which are required inputs for the structuring rule in rules_engine.
Apply the named structuring rule to flag accounts with multiple sub-threshold transactions indicative of deliberate avoidance of the $10,000 reporting requirement.
Translate rule hits into a weighted LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH risk rating for each flagged account, prioritising analyst review.

skipped.reason: The query is narrowly targeted at a specific typology and date window — a broad EDA summary adds no value here.
The typology (structuring) is well-defined and directly answerable by rules alone; the anomaly model is not needed for a scoped threshold question and would add noise without insight.
Structuring detection is a single-account pattern; no network, ring, or counterparty analysis is implied by this query.
